title: MicroservicePrd:Meet

_meta.purpose: Meet source-authority lock and source map: authorizes source-backed Plan/Spec and RED fixture decomposition for meeting rooms, participant/lobby, media/session control, captions/transcription, recording handoff, webinar/breakout, live-stream egress, and E2E meeting encryption. This artifact does not authorize runtime implementation or production-readiness claims.

authority_resolution.manifest_index_boundary: The manifests-index meet row marks oya/meet/manifest.json as tracked service inventory/provenance only and says no specs/microservices/meet.json PRD/source-authority file existed before this task. This artifact is the source lock for later planning; the manifest alone remains insufficient for RED/Build or readiness claims.
authority_resolution.legacy_root_disposition: Paths beginning microservices/meet/ that appear inside oya/meet/manifest.json are legacy provenance/path-discovery inputs only. Future cards must use current oya/meet/** paths when they exist, or quarantine the legacy reference as unresolved rather than recreating the legacy root.
authority_resolution.claim_boundary: Source authority for planning, source-map validation, and future RED-contract decomposition only. No handler, storage adapter, media plane, deployment, live SLO, production readiness, hyperscaler maturity, GA, external availability, or customer-facing readiness claim is made by this artifact.

identity.service_boundary: Tenant-scoped workplace meeting service for room/session lifecycle, participant and lobby policy, audio/video/screen-share control, recording bridge handoff, transcription/captions/summaries, webinar/breakout/live-stream modes, and opt-in E2E meeting encryption. Calendar, recordings, intelligence, notes/drive, identity, tenancy, audit-chain, ontology, observability, and workflow-engine remain separate service boundaries connected by explicit contracts.
identity.crate_claim_boundary: Catalog and crate names are inventory/source-map candidates only until a RED/Build card verifies current files, package metadata, and compile/test evidence.

critical_user_stories: employee host creates or starts a tenant-scoped meeting from workspace/calendar context
attendee joins through lobby, acknowledges recording/transcription consent, then mutes/unmutes and toggles camera
presenter starts/stops screen share with visible state and keyboard path
host starts/stops recording and sees retention/legal-hold/consent disclosure
participant uses live captions/transcript and sees language/error states
AV coordinator runs board-mode preflight, consent matrix, executive session, captioning, and archive flow where j163 scope is selected
accessibility_acceptance_floor: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum for any user-facing meet surface
keyboard-only operation for join, leave, mute, camera, screen share, lobby admit/deny, caption toggle, and recording consent controls
screen-reader labels and live-region updates for participant state, recording/transcription status, captions, and errors
visible focus order and no spinner-only waiting state for lobby, SFU placement, or caption startup
captions/transcript controls support reduced motion, high contrast, localization, and clear consent/policy disclosure
browser_user_story_accessibility_expecta.evidence_required_before_merge: Browser or user-story replay evidence is required for UI-facing Build slices; if no UI is touched, the review must record an explicit N/A rationale and still replay API/contract paths.
